memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the LORD. At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in." Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly. Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD instructed through Moses. - Num 27:21-23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
As Joshua is commissioned, God sets a limit and a support around his leadership. Joshua would not act alone or by his own wisdom; he was to stand before Eleazar the priest, who would seek God's direction through the sacred means God had appointed. Even the great new leader was to lead in dependence on the Lord's guidance.

This is a wise and humbling arrangement. Joshua, for all his gifting, was not to be a law unto himself. He was placed under God's authority, needing to inquire of the Lord for the community's direction. The strongest leaders are those who know they must continually seek God rather than trust their own understanding.

Then Moses obeys, laying his hands on Joshua and commissioning him before the whole assembly. It was a moment of transition marked by obedience and order. Moses did exactly as the Lord commanded, handing over leadership faithfully and publicly. The passing of the mantle was done God's way, in God's timing.

For us, this points to the importance of leading and living in dependence on God. No one, however gifted, is meant to walk alone by their own wisdom. In Christ, we have a Leader who always did the Father's will and who now guides us by His Spirit and His Word (John 5:19). Follow Him closely, and lead others only as you yourself are led by God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you seek God's direction or rely on your own understanding?
2. How does Joshua's dependence on God challenge your own leadership?
3. What does it mean to follow Christ, who always did the Father's will?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, keep me from relying on my own wisdom. Teach me to lead and live in constant dependence on You, following Christ who always did Your will and now guides me by Your Spirit. Amen.
